name: naac-assistant
description: Convenience scripts only. server/ and client/ are independent npm projects with their own lockfiles.

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build --prefix client
